cases.code: Write a complete Python module implementing a thread-safe LRU cache with TTL expiration, an injectable clock, capacity validation, get, put, delete and clear methods. Include a unittest test suite covering expiration, eviction order, updates, missing keys, invalid capacity, and concurrent access. Explain the invariants briefly. Return executable code.
cases.prose: Explain how database transactions implement atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability. Compare write-ahead logging, snapshot isolation and serializable execution using concrete examples of concurrent bank transfers. Discuss crash recovery and common application mistakes. Write a detailed technical tutorial.

fault_counter_scope: Linux counters of the launched process; wrapper child processes are excluded. Decode fault deltas start when the client receives the first token.
metric: decode_tps = DONE generated / DONE decode_ms * 1000; client_decode_tps excludes first token; warmup excluded from weighted rate
